[SWS_CM_99032] Send event where Communication Management is responsible for the data
⌈
As defined in [SWS_CM_90437], the Send method of the specific Event
class where the Communication Management is responsible for the data and the ap-
plication is not allowed to access the data after sending shall be used whenever the
data is created explicitly for sending and no further processing is happening afterward
by the application itself.
Before sending the event, the corresponding data has to be requested from the Com-
munication Management (see [SWS_CM_99033]) and filled with the respective data.
⌋
